name: Focus Style Regression Guard
summary: Block newly invisible CSS focus states that have no visible replacement.
description: Parses bounded CSS rule blocks and rejects net-new focus selectors that disable outlines without a visible outline, shadow, border, or text-decoration replacement.
risk_reason: This automatic gate blocks newly invisible CSS focus states that have no visible replacement; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not evaluate rendered contrast or pixel visibility.
It does not reject outline removal when the same focus rule, or a `:focus-visible` rule for the same subject element, supplies a visible replacement.
It does not claim keyboard accessibility conformance.

entrypoints.purpose: Block newly invisible CSS focus states that have no visible replacement.

operational.latency_reason: The entrypoint handles one intercepted event to block newly invisible CSS focus states that have no visible replacement without deferred work.
